channel.title: Gabriel Hasik Risk Briefings
channel.description: Cybersecurity, third-party risk, supply chain security, AI governance, regulatory resilience, and monitoring briefings by Gabriel Hasik.

item.title: NIS2 and the Extended Supply Chain: When Your Small Supplier Becomes Your Biggest Risk
item.description: How NIS2 expectations cascade through supplier ecosystems and why small suppliers can create large cyber risk.

item.title: From Checkbox to Culture: Building a Third-Party Risk Program That Actually Works
item.description: A practical guide to building a third-party risk program that moves beyond questionnaires and creates real supplier risk governance.

item.title: Cybersecurity Is Now a Board Problem - Personal Liability Under NIS2 and DORA
item.description: NIS2 and DORA move cybersecurity governance into the boardroom. Management teams need evidence that they understand cyber risk, supplier dependencies, resilience, and incident response.

item.title: Third-Party Risk Intelligence Briefing - June to August 2026
item.description: Software supply chain compromise, AI Act enforcement, DORA and UK critical third-party oversight, and vendor concentration risk.

item.title: Geopolitical Supply Chain Risks - June to August 2026
item.description: Red Sea escalation, EU Russia sanctions, rare earth concentration, Arctic shipping, and supply chain bottlenecks.

item.title: AI Is Now a Supply Chain Risk
item.description: AI has become one of the most concentrated and least-governed supply chains in the enterprise.

item.title: The Supply Chain Is Now the Biggest Cyber Threat
item.description: Why supply chain compromise has become a primary cyber threat, with data, incident patterns, regulatory expectations, and practical controls.
